title: Zur Bedeutung des Geruchssinnes beim Nahrungserwerb von Kröten (Amphibia, Anura, Bufonidae): Versuche mit der Kreuzkröte (Bufo calamita Laur.)
why: Abstract confirms visual and olfactory prey-stimulus experiments in eight adult natterjacks but states no visual result; full text is needed to determine whether moving-prey responses were tested and what they showed.
